encounter.name: HAWA
traits: Advantage on saving throws against charmed. Cannot be put to sleep by magic.
As a bonus action HAWA can expend a spell slot to cause her melee attacks to magically deal an extra 3d6 radiant damage on a hit.
HAWA has advantage on all spell attack rolls and saving throw DCs when the moon is visible. In Barovia the moon is always visible — the Stone ensures this.
HAWA cannot be frightened or charmed by undead creatures.
Crowd control spells against Tier 2 or lower enemies are automatically successful on the first casting per encounter.

spellcasting.At Will: guidance, light, thaumaturgy, spare the dying

spellcasting.1st (4 slots): bless, cure wounds, detect magic, sanctuary

spellcasting.2nd (3 slots): augury, hold person, lesser restoration, spiritual weapon

spellcasting.3rd (3 slots): daylight, mass healing word, spirit guardians

spellcasting.4th (3 slots): banishment, death ward, guardian of faith

spellcasting.5th (2 slots): commune, greater restoration, mass cure wounds

actions: HAWA makes two Sacred Flame attacks or one melee attack and casts a bonus action spell.
Ranged spell attack +10 to hit range 60 ft. Hit 3d8 radiant damage. Ignores cover.
+6 to hit reach 5 ft. Hit 1d6+2 bludgeoning + 2d8 radiant damage.
Each undead within 30 ft must succeed DC 18 Wisdom save or be turned for 1 minute. Undead of CR 5 or lower are destroyed outright.

HAWA calls down concentrated moonlight in a 5ft radius 40ft cylinder. Creatures in the area make DC 18 Constitution save or take 6d10 radiant damage (half on save). Vampires and undead have disadvantage on this save.
bonus_actions: Expend a spell slot to add 3d6 radiant to next melee attack.
Expend spell slot to heal one creature within 60 ft — 1d4 + Wisdom modifier per slot level.
reactions: When attacked impose disadvantage on the attack roll by interposing moonlight.

traits.name: Divine Presence
traits.desc: The Aspect cannot be surprised, magically put to sleep, or unwillingly transformed.

traits.name: Moonlight Ward
traits.desc: Creatures of the Aspect's choice within 30 feet gain advantage on saves against fear and charm.

traits.name: Lunar Distortion
traits.desc: The first attack made against the Aspect each round has disadvantage.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The Aspect is a 15th-level spellcaster. Spellcasting ability: Wisdom (save DC 21, +13 spell attack)
Cantrips (at will): Sacred Flame, Toll the Dead, Guidance, Light, Word of Radiance
1st level (4 slots): Shield, Bless, Healing Word, Guiding Bolt
2nd level (3 slots): Misty Step, Moonbeam, Lesser Restoration
3rd level (3 slots): Spirit Guardians, Counterspell, Revivify
4th level (3 slots): Banishment, Death Ward, Guardian of Faith
5th level (2 slots): Wall of Light, Greater Restoration
6th level (1 slot): Sunbeam
7th level (1 slot): Plane Shift
8th level (1 slot): Holy Aura

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Aspect makes one Moon Rod attack and casts a cantrip.

actions.name: Moon Rod
actions.desc:
Melee Spell Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target
Hit: 19 (3d6+9) radiant damage.

actions.name: Lunar Nova (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
Creatures within a 20-foot radius sphere within 120 feet make DC 21 Constitution saves.
Failure: 38 (8d8) radiant damage and blinded until end of their next turn.
Success: Half damage.

bonus_actions.name: Lunar Step
bonus_actions.desc: Teleport up to 30 feet to an area of dim light or moonlight.

reactions.name: Moon Shield
reactions.desc: When hit by an attack, the Aspect gains +4 AC until the start of her next turn.
